fullTextZH: 今天我要给大家说小红马的故事.
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell everyone the story of the little red horse.

fullTextZH: 在一个很远很远的农场,
fullTextEN: On a very far away farm,
there was a farmer,
he had 3 animals,
a pig, a cow,
and a little red horse.
These three animals,
he liked the little red horse the most.
One year,
the winter was very cold,
the farmer had nothing to eat,
he thought,

fullTextZH: 看来我要吃掉我的动物.
fullTextEN: it seems I have to eat my animals.
Although he really didn't want to,
but he couldn't find food,
he was very hungry,
so he said to the little pig:
"Sorry, little pig,
it seems I can only eat you,
but, do you have any wishes?"
Little Pig: "Alright,
if you are going to eat me,

fullTextZH: 那最后请你给我一顿大餐,
fullTextEN: then please give me a big meal at the end,

fullTextZH: 我想要吃我爱吃的东西."
fullTextEN: I want to eat what I love to eat."

fullTextZH: 那农民找了很多菜给猪吃,
fullTextEN: Then the farmer found a lot of food for the pig to eat,
The pig was very satisfied,
then the farmer killed it.
After 15 days,

fullTextZH: 农夫现在又没有吃的了,
fullTextEN: the farmer now had nothing to eat again,
he thought, oh dear,
what should I do,
I have nothing to eat,
the little pig has already been eaten,
what should I eat now,
now I will eat the calf.
Right, he said: "Calf,
I'm really sorry,
I don't want to eat you,

fullTextZH: 但是今年的冬天特别冷,
fullTextEN: but this winter is especially cold,
I can't find anything to eat,
I can only eat you now,
Before I kill you,
Do you have any wishes?"
The little cow said:
"Okay, I understand,
I know you want to kill me,

fullTextZH: 那你可以让我休息几天吗?
fullTextEN: Can you let me rest for a few days?
I am always working,
I am too tired."
The farmer said: "Okay,
I will let you rest for a few days."
The little cow rested for a few days,
then the farmer killed him.
Another 15 days passed,
This winter is especially cold,
The farmer has nothing to eat again,
Now he only has the little red horse,
This little red horse is so cute,
I like it so much,
I really don't want to eat it.
But the farmer had no way,

fullTextZH: 他对小红马说："亲爱的小红马,
fullTextEN: He said to the little red horse: "Dear little red horse,
Sorry, I really like you,
But I am very hungry,
I want to eat you,

fullTextZH: 现在你可以告诉我一个愿望."
fullTextEN: Now you can tell me a wish."
The little red horse thought for a moment,
The little red horse said: "Do you know,

fullTextZH: 我不喜欢这个故事,再见,
fullTextEN: I don't like this story, goodbye,
I want to go to another story."
So the little red horse ran away,
The little red horse left the farmer,

fullTextZH: 跑到另一个故事里去了.
fullTextEN: Ran to another story.

fullTextZH: 所以我觉得这个故事告诉我们:
fullTextEN: So I think this story tells us:

fullTextZH: "我们每个人都有不同的选择,
fullTextEN: "Each of us has different choices,

fullTextZH: 我们的人生也是自己的选择,
fullTextEN: Our life is also our own choice,

fullTextZH: 你可以像猪一样吃一顿好吃的,
fullTextEN: You can eat like a pig,

fullTextZH: 也可以像小牛一样休息几天."
fullTextEN: Or rest for a few days like a calf."

fullTextZH: 但是,别忘了,你也可以选择自由.
fullTextEN: But, don't forget, you can also choose freedom.
That is the little red horse's choice.

fullTextZH: 我们有时候以为自己没有选择,
fullTextEN: Sometimes we think we have no choice,

fullTextZH: 但是其实我们做什么都可以,
fullTextEN: but actually we can do anything,

fullTextZH: 希望你喜欢这个故事,下次见.
fullTextEN: I hope you like this story, see you next time.
